# Telemetry export pipeline (FigDown)

I don't have `reference/scene.md`/`reference/layout.md` loaded in this session, so I've kept the block-genre syntax to the minimal, unambiguous forms the core spec itself shows (bare ids, quoted labels, plain `->` edges) and avoided any layout/pin or class machinery the figure doesn't need. Five nodes, four edges, exactly as the description states — poller and health probe both feed normalizer, normalizer feeds buffer, buffer feeds exporter.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

block poller "Poller"
block healthprobe "Health probe"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block buffer "Ring buffer"
block exporter "Exporter"

poller -> normalizer
healthprobe -> normalizer
normalizer -> buffer
buffer -> exporter
```

Next step per the workflow: `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js telemetry-export-pipeline.fd`, fix any `Line N:` errors it reports (in particular, confirm the exact `block`-opener and edge-arrow spellings against `reference/scene.md` if the build rejects either), then embed the resulting SVG with the standard `source:` footer pointing at this `.fd`.
